title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Bartolomeo recursive mnemonic prefix trees preserve written child order across multiple compression tiers
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Direct inspection of Vatican Vat.lat.3677 first-foliation ff17v–18r shows 100 leaf mnemonic strings→20 group strings→4 higher strings→2 page roots. Ordered child-prefix concatenation visibly operates in a first branch and is invariant under a shared one-to-one letter renaming. This offers a content-free falsifier before lexical guesses, but neither complete all-node transcription nor Voynich hierarchy ownership is established. Not a full propositional translation.

design.historical_law: The lowest strings abbreviate four ordered image names (thesis example TRI PE COR VE). The native diagram then brackets five strings into a second-tier string, five such strings into a third-tier string, and two third-tier strings into one page root. Two pages display the whole catalogue. First branch visually takes Tri/Me/Ma/Phi/Ci in that order; full diplomatic collation is still required.

finite_contrast.recursive_onsets: At every owned internal node, parent equals concatenation of nonempty prefixes of its ordered child strings, with no omitted/reordered/duplicated child and no inserted parent material. Source collation must establish actual clipping conventions before a target contract.
finite_contrast.flat_index: Each image bundle receives a mnemonic code, but group labels have no obligatory relation to their child codes.
finite_contrast.literal_sentence: A parent is a grammatical statement about its children; no mandatory character-prefix reconstruction is implied.

design.bijection_invariant: For one fixed character bijection E extended by concatenation, E(parent)=E(prefix(child1))...E(prefix(childN)); prefix lengths are preserved. Thus the necessary written equality can be checked without knowing sounds, Latin words or English meanings. It does not survive arbitrary homophony, variable-length substitutions or freely regrouped transcription units unless separately specified.
design.why_potentially_useful: A single established hierarchy would constrain many whole strings simultaneously through order and exact identity, rather than independently guessing one meaning per word. Repeated prefixes could be inherited address/cue material rather than recurrent narrow content words. This is only a candidate explanation, not a finding about any Voynich family.
why_likely_useless_or_nonidentifying: A manuscript may store only final cues; no child table survives, so this law cannot be checked there.
Allowing arbitrary ownership, ordering, variable segmentation and very short one-character clips may admit chance fits; those freedoms must be declared and controlled across the whole search.
The mnemonic recovers a learned catalogue; even a real prefix tree does not recover object names or propositions without that catalogue.
The source topology does not authorize assuming five-way groups or four-slot words in Voynich.
Source example preserves image-name order, not verbs, negation or full narrative syntax.
design.smallest_next_step: Collate one complete native five-child branch, its five four-name source entries, and the next-tier parent using the already available Vatican images/text lists; distinguish copied onsets from exceptions. Root may then nominate one independently owned already-admitted hierarchy for a separate prospective contract. No target search authorized by this card.
design.target_evidence: No Voynich bodies, images or reserves read; no native hierarchy or word assignment selected. No test performed.
design.prior_structural_constraints: Known productive directed composition, whole-form residuals and reader-specific segmentation are retained. No learned unit is declared an alphabet. All word meanings remain unassigned; any later meaning requires existing exact profile and counterexample review.

predecessors.retained: Strict FST34/V2 card-merger binding remains UNSAT. Its arbitrary primitive-card mapping and paid overrides differ from exact source-visible prefix inheritance; no repair or reopening.

Already proposes label as initials of a heading. Current distinction is explicit multiple-tier historical tree whose internal strings themselves generate higher strings. A single label/heading match would duplicate this route and is insufficient.
Mnemonic syllogistic proof words encode proposition types and proof operations; this catalogue tree encodes ordered names, not a proof grammar.
Guide-to-rubric expansion requires manufacture evidence. Current tree is visible completed nested compression, not inferred chronological guide marks.
A simple bijective cipher cannot erase statistical/algebraic differences; this source demonstrates a nonliteral mnemonic representation before any renaming, not a rescue of a literal Latin cipher.

design.duplicate_screen_limit: Bounded route-check recursive mnemonic first syllables Bartolomeo; ideas searches Bartolomeo compound syllable, recursive mnemonic, acrostic, synopsis, recursive prefix; read GDT616 report, IP052 primary, own guide-mark primary and IDEA387 card. Search absence is not proof of universal novelty.
design.claim_ceiling: Source production mechanism with an explicit necessary surface constraint. No decoder, semantic identification, Voynich correspondence or confidence claim.
